final: WITH color_stats AS (SELECT product_color AS color, AVG(unit_price) AS avg_price, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Products GROUP BY product_color), count_avg AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM color_stats WHERE cnt IS NOT NULL), kept AS (SELECT c.color, c.avg_price, c.cnt, c.cnt - a.avg_cnt AS cnt_diff FROM color_stats c CROSS JOIN count_avg a WHERE a.avg_cnt IS NOT NULL AND c.cnt > a.avg_cnt) SELECT AVG(avg_price) AS avg_of_avg_prices, AVG(cnt) AS avg_of_counts, AVG(cnt_diff) AS avg_of_count_diffs FROM kept
